display_long_description:
Project Collision — is a multiplayer virtual reality game where you become a legless gorilla and interact with the world only through the movements of your hands. Break away from reality and immerse yourself in a world of simple, physically active fun.

🎯 Key Game Features

· Unique Movement: Run, climb, and jump by physically swinging your arms and pushing off surfaces. There are no buttons or joysticks—your body becomes the controller.
· Game Modes for Every Taste: From dynamic competitions to relaxed socializing. Take part in epic team battles in Paintbrawl mode or chase a personal goal in Hunt mode.
· Social Space: Beyond the games, you can simply chat and hang out with friends or new acquaintances in the dedicated non-competitive Casual mode.
· Freedom of Expression: Visit the in-game shop to purchase and wear various hats, glasses, clothing, and other cosmetic items.

🦍 How to Play

The gameplay is based on intuitive movements:

· To run, swing your arms as if you were running in place.
· To jump, simply press your palms against the ground or any surface and push off.
· To climb a tree or ledge, grab onto it with both hands and pull yourself up.

These simple rules are easy to learn, but it takes practice to become a true parkour master in gorilla form.

🌍 Game Worlds

Explore diverse maps, play with friends, and have a blast.
